does: Chops coriander and parsley fine and stirs them with crushed garlic, cumin, paprika, lemon juice, olive oil and salt into a thick, loose green paste that is used to marinate fish and to season the vegetables it cooks on.
how: Wash and dry the herbs well, so that the paste is not watery.
Chop the herbs fine, stalks and all for coriander, since the thin stalks hold much of the taste.
Crush the garlic with a little salt.
Stir everything together with the spices, the lemon juice and the oil.
Taste: it should be sharp, salty and strong, since it seasons the whole dish.

cues.text: A loose, bright green paste flecked red with paprika.
Sharp, salty and strongly herby, with the warmth of cumin.

mistakes.mistake: Chopping the herbs wet, so that the paste turns watery and bruised.
mistakes.fix: Dry the herbs well before chopping.

mistakes.mistake: Seasoning it timidly, so that the finished dish tastes flat.
mistakes.fix: Make it stronger than seems right. It is spread over a lot of fish and vegetables.

comes_after.why: The herbs and the garlic must be cut fine first.
